headline: Expiry‑day trades are hurting your results

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: These expiry‑day trades accounted for 90 trades and produced a loss of ₹1,16,891, averaging a loss of ₹1,299 per trade with a win rate of 29% and an average return of a 28% loss. The remaining 124 trades generated a loss of ₹449 on average, a win rate of 37% and an average return of a 5% loss. The cost of this slice was ₹1,16,891.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider applying this rule in the next window to curb expiry‑day losses.
